verdict.rationale: Windmill offers AI Agent steps that let users wire LLM calls into flows to process data, and an MCP server/AI-generation feature for building scripts, but these are developer-facing building blocks rather than a built-in 'insights and suggestions from my data' feature (e.g., no dashboard/analytics AI surfaced automatically on stored data). Missing for 10: evidence of an out-of-the-box AI analytics/insights UI, proactive suggestions surfaced to end users without building a flow, and any independent corroboration of this specific use case.
